summary: In this tafseer of Surat Al-Anbiya, Sheikh Ali Mashhour explains the Quranic statement that humans were created from haste, describing haste as an innate human nature that requires constant discipline to overcome. He elaborates on how the Quraysh mocked Prophet Muhammad and the Day of Resurrection, asking when punishment would come, and how Allah responds by noting that such punishment comes suddenly without warning. The sheikh emphasizes that true worship of Allah requires tawhid (monotheism) as a fundamental condition, comparing it to how wudu is essential for prayer. He concludes by explaining Allah's logical arguments against shirk (polytheism), demonstrating that only Allah deserves worship and that Islam alone offers pure monotheism.
